description: Chromium page resize sync (cef-resize-sync-bench.py, STRESS bench: every pane a Chromium page): layer hosting off (the child-window baseline), checked first with cef-layer-verify.py; modes on and on0 are not run, because they need a fork with every Track A call (API 34) and the pin is API 30; per mode, layout and action (split, close, column, drag) each round's Core Animation commit p95 and max (the page's resize wait), frame interval p95 and p99 and missed frames, and the modes that were not valid, stress session.
